name: Kiran Jagtap
player_statement:
A complete player, Kiran Jagtap has made a big mark in cricket. With 13 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 15*, with an average of 10.60 and a quick strike rate of 99.07. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 7 sixes and 4 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 20.4 overs, taking 13 wickets at an economy rate of 10.31. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
